observed_failure_definition: Trials absent from the complete-case dataset because at least one source stream was not indexed, empty, or incompatible with the required schema. No test labels select failure cases.

schema_replay_definition.note: A1 is a rereferencing channel rather than a model input. The conservative observed_eeg_rejected condition marks the whole EEG stream unavailable; the attenuation sweep replays only the seven directly corresponding model-input channels.

inference: For subjects present in the complete-case cohort, only their subject-disjoint held-out fold is used. A subject absent from all complete folds is evaluated by a fixed five-fold ensemble and reported separately from the internal comparison.
